integrity.claim_scope: finite rooted metric tree; L-infinity to L-infinity approximation numbers
integrity.proof_method: weighted edge partitions, nodal interpolation, disjoint zero-integral tent witnesses

scientific_limitations: Weights u and v are strictly positive continuous functions.
The claim gives the asymptotic coefficient, not exact finite-n approximation numbers.

title: Exact endpoint asymptotics for weighted Hardy operators on finite metric trees
